newsitem.title: GERMANY: Springer to launch new consumer magazine - report.
newsitem.headline: Springer to launch new consumer magazine - report.

text.p: German publisher Axel Springer Verlag is planning to publish a new consumer magazine, Germany's Der Spiegel magazine reported on Saturday.
Spiegel said Springer, which publishes weekly magazines on cars, sports and computers, was planning to launch a magazine about consumer issues to be called "Geld-Bild".
The new magazine was expected to undergo consumer testing within the coming weeks.
A Springer spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
